    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架2025年8月简报</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907231809101-123276124.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>公众号每月定期推广和分享的C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架（每周至少会推荐两个优秀的项目和框架当然节假日除外），公众号推文中有项目和框架的详细介绍、功能特点、使用方式以及部分功能截图等（打不开或者打开GitHub很慢的同学可以优先查看公众号推文，文末一定会附带项目和框架源码地址）。注意：排名不分先后，都是十分优秀的开源项目和框架，每周定期更新分享。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>💡简报Gitee开源地址：https://gitee.com/ysgdaydayup/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</strong></li>
<li><strong>🔔简报GitHub开源地址：https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</strong></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>AtomUI</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;AtomUI 是一款基于 Ant Design 设计语言实现、漂亮的 .NET Avalonia UI 控件库，致力于将 Ant Design 优秀而高效的设计语言和体验带入 Avalonia/.NET 跨平台桌面软件开发领域。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/chinware/atomui</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516186&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=6e9b19eedba821c2099313419167c151&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/QMjNkb-YQXAfHKKLaH23tQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202508/1336199-20250823142755484-176186159.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202508/1336199-20250823142919224-2044591669.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202508/1336199-20250823142925405-580189610.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>dnGrep</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;dnGrep 是一款基于 .NET 开源、功能强大的 Windows 搜索工具，它支持在多个文件中进行搜索，并以易于阅读的结果呈现。你可以通过文本、正则表达式、XPath 和语音查询搜索文本文件、Word 和 Excel 文档、PDF 文件以及存档文件中进行搜索。dnGrep 还提供了搜索和替换、整文件预览、在文件资源管理器中右键搜索等更多功能。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/dnGrep/dnGrep</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516199&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=9abe7f9510f2afea8c2b1e05dfb52959&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/2LFsMAEdj8i0QVZJmFWsjA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907231923477-125033318.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907231928254-2026947451.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>UrShop</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;UrShop 是一款基于原生微信小程序 + .NET Core + Layui 技术构建、开源（GPL-3.0）、功能全面的微信小程序商城系统，项目包微信小程序端和后台管理端。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/urselect/urshop</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516281&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=7dc108e736dbfb42c1c409d7d188ec51&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/ArLHsMB2eBJMadQkjaPehw</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907231958382-1047598869.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232002665-1408680802.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232008209-1732754873.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232013664-1630049736.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>EasyCaching</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;EasyCaching 是一个 .NET 开源（MIT license）、免费的缓存库，包含了缓存的基本用法和一些高级用法，可以帮助开发者更轻松地处理缓存。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/dotnetcore/EasyCaching</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516242&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=d009ab06878ad99dac24c2df78d5086d&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/gV2gd6voIc0_tMwzTyi4ig</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232026202-2045405320.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>PixiEditor</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;PixiEditor 是一款基于 .NET 构建、开源（LGPL-3.0 license）、功能强大、通用的 2D 图形编辑器，旨在为您提供满足所有 2D 需求的工具和功能。为您的游戏、动画创建精美的精灵，编辑图片，设计标志。所有功能都集成在一个直观且熟悉的界面中。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/PixiEditor/PixiEditor</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516292&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=e47e691830e81c6b16bc3fc34b4103d1&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Bx7NvrlZ-Vx9BZyMyWHdpw</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232041693-1549567463.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>DCWriterLite</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;DCWriterLite 是一个基于 .NET 开源（Apache-2.0 license）、功能强大的在线文档编辑器，与 TinyMCE 和 CKEditor 等基于浏览器的 HTML DOM 开发的其他软件不同，DCWriterLite 构建自己的 DOM 结构，使用 XML 存储文档，并使用 Canvas 进行文档渲染，使用 SVG 进行文档打印。这使得 DCWriterLite 能够克服 HTML DOM 的局限性并实现高度先进的文档编辑功能，例如实时分页、可靠的重做/撤消功能和强大的表单字段。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/DCWriterLite</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516259&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=1ab7598c492c2cf2bf2a83b1842250ab&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/NkCdPxovI7DqdCgjJu5LXA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232058188-722677244.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232102887-17442381.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232108106-1367077126.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>AntFlow.NET</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;AntFlow.NET 是一款基于 .NET + Vue + FreeSql + Natasha 编写的仿钉钉的开源（Apache-2.0）低代码工作流引擎，支持多种数据库，让工作流开发像普通 CURD 一样简单，即使没有流程开发经验的程序员也能快速开发流程，效率提升利器。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/antswarm/antflowcore</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247515877&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=74cdc6b9de6e421ab28919e87f1b11bf&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/K_LhxrveXVVNATN45YbArw</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232120562-1504982934.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232125558-200829345.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232131228-377187285.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>MdXaml</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;MdXaml 是一款基于 WPF 开源（MIT license）、免费、轻量级的 Markdown 编辑器，旨在为用户提供一个直观、高效的 Markdown 编辑环境。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/whistyun/MdXaml</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247515963&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=f6271b01e244b5199ce8c0a780ebdcfa&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/wad9ACh8iPfSxPq_HHMOxQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232143891-199522199.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232148749-1361471514.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Sundial</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Sundial 是一个基于 .NET 开源（MIT License）、功能齐全的分布式作业调度系统，它可从最小的应用程序到大型企业系统使用。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/dotnetchina/Sundial</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247515934&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=31a663ec7ad8d6ef64fa2848c504fd84&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/36EH7J5DUZPaymPTTofs3w</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202509/1336199-20250907232201625-1821938223.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>TulingMember</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;TulingMember 是一款使用 .NET 6 开发，基于 Furion 框架与 ViewUI 构建的极简进销存管理系统。该项目旨在为企业提供一套轻量级、易扩展、易维护的进销存解决方案，帮助企业高效管理商品、销售、采购、库存及财务等核心业务。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/a106_admin/tuling-member</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247516019&amp;idx=2&amp;sn=079bc9235d71bdf6e013323793c5059d&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/_FMpo53ahk52G4x6siFVzw</a></span></li>
</ul>
